capability.summary: Transpile SQL text between two SQLGlot dialects
capability.description: Passes one SQL string to sqlglot.transpile with a source dialect defaulting to mysql and target dialect defaulting to postgres, returning the generated statement strings as a list.
capability.problem_space: Syntactic SQL dialect translation for one input string using SQLGlot's parser and generator.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: SQL string, source dialect name, and target dialect name; output: JSON result array of transpiled SQL statement strings.
accepted_inputs: SQL text parseable by the specified SQLGlot read dialect
read and write dialect identifiers recognized by the installed SQLGlot version
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.sqlglot_transpile", and result as an array of SQL statement strings generated in the requested write dialect. A caught source-SQL parse, dialect-resolution, transpilation, or target-generation exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.sqlglot_transpile", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: performs syntax translation only and does not connect to a database, execute SQL, inspect schemas, or verify runtime equivalence
uses SQLGlot defaults with no caller control over pretty printing, identifier quoting, normalization, comments, or unsupported-feature policy
dialect translation can be lossy or approximate for constructs without direct target equivalents
the wrapper defaults missing read and write arguments to mysql and postgres even though the manifest declares them required
parse, dialect, and generation exceptions use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Array of SQL statement strings generated in the requested target dialect.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: execute SQL or validate it against a live database
guarantee semantic equivalence across database engines
format SQL without selecting source and target dialect behavior
